bank_name: ICB Islamic Bank Limited (formerly The Oriental Bank Limited / Al-Baraka Bank Bangladesh Limited)
period_note: Filed by the bank as a '2nd quarter un-audited' filing (a discrete Q2 balance sheet/P&L, not separately labelled 'Half Yearly'). Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) vs 31-Dec-2018. Income-statement items recorded here are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2019 (H1 YTD). SOLO/STANDALONE basis. Source PDF is a low-quality scan of a newspaper-format financial disclosure (masthead 'The New Nation Dhaka, Sunday, 13 July 2019' visible); OCR (pdftoppm 300dpi -> tesseract 5.5.3) is noticeably noisier for this filing than most others in this dataset -- many cells have dropped or transposed digits. CONFIDENCE TIERS: balance-sheet line items below are HIGH confidence, reconstructed via the balance-sheet identity and cross-checked against known figures (retained earnings -18,424,779,108 vs Dec-18's already-known -18,230,405,451 per 2019_Q1.json; total equity -11,144,994,225 independently confirmed by dividing into the source's own printed NAV/share of -16.77 -- exact match; total assets recovered as liabilities 22,782,286,679 + equity, matching the OCR's garbled 'Total assets' fragment once its dropped leading digit is restored). Profit-before-tax, tax and net-profit-after-tax are also HIGH confidence, solved jointly via the printed EPS of -0.29 (PBT -192,908,357, tax +1,465,300, PAT -194,373,657 is the unique combination consistent with both the chain PBT-tax=PAT and EPS=PAT/664,702,300 shares). Total operating income (A) is MEDIUM confidence, summed from individually-legible income sub-lines that mutually corroborate the H1-2018 comparative column against 2018_Q2.json. Operating expenses (B), operating profit before provision (C) and the provision charge (D) are LOWER confidence, backed out algebraically from A and PBT because their own printed cells were the most heavily garbled in this file; the specific-provision sign (recovery vs charge) was inferred from consistency with this bank's operating-expense run-rate in adjacent quarters rather than read directly. NOCFPS (-0.45) is reported directly and legible.
